page: Microsoft Azure F2amds_v7 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the Famdsv7 server family. It is equipped with 2 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor operating at a high clock speed of 4.5 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core, and is bundled with 236 GB of local storage. This instance runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and supports Premium Storage.

In benchmark evaluations, the F2amds_v7 exhibits strong single-core performance. The stress-ng single-core CPU test, gzip single-threaded compression, and bzip3 single-threaded decompression all rank in the top tier (top 10%). However, multi-threaded performance is more constrained due to the 2-core limit, with stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and PassMark CPU scores falling into the average category, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression registering as weak. Memory bandwidth and database operations, including Redis SET operations, consistently perform at average levels.

Given its high memory-to-core ratio and strong single-threaded performance, the F2amds_v7 offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require massive parallelization. The inclusion of 236 GB of local storage and Premium Storage capability makes it suitable for small-scale databases, caching layers, and memory-bound utility tasks. It is also well-suited for lightweight web serving, single-threaded data processing, and development environments requiring dedicated CPU resources.
